summary: Eight granular storage protocol interfaces implemented as Python typing.Protocol classes. Each protocol defines one capability: StorageConnectionProtocol (connect/disconnect), StorageReadProtocol (read_to_stream), StorageWriteProtocol (write_from_bytes, write_from_stream), StorageListProtocol (list_files, list_directories), StorageDeleteProtocol (delete_file), StorageMetadataProtocol (path_exists, get_metadata, get_size), StorageCopyProtocol (copy), StorageDirectoryProtocol (mkdir, rmdir). Backends implement protocols à la carte; the facade checks conformance at runtime via isinstance.
extension_points: Implement any subset of protocols to create a new backend; unimplemented operations raise UnsupportedOperationError at runtime
lifecycle_notes: StorageReadProtocol requires read_to_stream() not read_bytes() — streaming is the primitive
StorageWriteProtocol requires both write_from_bytes and write_from_stream
documentation_hooks: Extension authors must implement each protocol method signature exactly — runtime isinstance checks enforce this
The facade documents which methods require which protocols (e.g., list_files needs StorageListProtocol)
risks: Changing a protocol method signature is a breaking change for all backends

evidence.detail: Verifies all registered backends implement required protocols
